useCases: It ranks by listed price only. It never says which site is "good" and never repeats a site's own claims such as "full strength" or "stable".
USD credit, CNY credit and cash prices are listed separately and never compared with each other.
Conditions such as a minimum top-up or members-only access are shown as a one-line hint. Prices that contradict the site's own text are list
